repos.name: zeabur-oss/zeabur
repos.description: Self-hosted PaaS on your own Kubernetes.
repos.one_liner: A self-hosted Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution that runs on your own Kubernetes cluster.
bullets: Built with Rust for high performance and memory safety in infrastructure management.
Simplifies deployment by abstracting Kubernetes complexity into a developer-friendly interface.
Ideal for teams needing private cloud infrastructure with the ease of use of managed services.
Supports automated scaling and environment management for production-grade applications.

repos.name: l0ng-ai/openidea
repos.description: The IDE you know, rebuilt in Rust. IntelliJ IDEA–style keymap, tool windows and search-everywhere in a fast native app: editor, code insight, debugger, Git, terminal, database and HTTP clients for 60+ languages.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, native IDE built in Rust that replicates the IntelliJ IDEA experience.
bullets: Engineered in Rust to provide a fast, native alternative to JVM-based development environments.
Includes integrated database clients, terminal, and Git tools for a comprehensive dev workflow.
Features IntelliJ-style keymaps and search-everywhere functionality for seamless developer migration.
Targets developers requiring low-latency code insight and debugging capabilities.

repos.name: google/elephant-goldfish-model
repos.description: An open-source method and skill set created at Google for spec-driven development with LLMs
repos.one_liner: An open-source methodology from Google for spec-driven development using LLMs.
bullets: Provides a structured framework for integrating LLMs into the software development lifecycle.
Focuses on spec-driven engineering to improve code reliability and architectural consistency.
Leverages AI agents to bridge the gap between high-level requirements and implementation.
Useful for enterprise teams looking to standardize AI-assisted coding practices.

repos.name: OpenBMB/MiniCPM-OCR
repos.description: An open-source OCR solution for fast, accurate document parsing with correctness assessment.
repos.one_liner: An open-source OCR solution optimized for fast, accurate document parsing and data extraction.
bullets: Utilizes advanced vision-language models to achieve high-precision text recognition.
Includes built-in correctness assessment to validate extracted data against source documents.
Highly applicable for fintech document processing, such as automated invoice or statement parsing.
Lightweight architecture allows for efficient deployment in data-heavy pipelines.

repos.name: feimacode/open-design-agent-kit
repos.description: Pro-grade UI design built into the coding agent you already use — GitHub Copilot Chat, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. 270+ design skills, 150+ brand design systems, 160+ remixable examples. No desktop app, no daemon, no API keys — just files in your repo.
repos.one_liner: A toolkit that integrates professional-grade UI design skills directly into coding agents.
bullets: Compatible with major AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
Contains 270+ design skills and 150+ brand design systems for automated UI generation.
Enables agentic workflows to produce production-ready frontend code with design consistency.
Reduces the feedback loop between design specifications and technical implementation.
